timeline.body: Cloudflare is investigating issues with Cloudflare Access. Customers may experience a delay making configuration changes to Access. We are working to understand the full impact and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
timeline.label: investigating

timeline.body: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.
